answer: A landline number tenure with exchange record works as the gate: a number held at one exchange for decades. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The sparrow signal separates the two cases at a glance: Each of 158 aliases needs its own number records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The quill ledger records each payment, the falcon window resets the board, and 158 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
